name: mean-boilerplate
description: Production-shaped MEAN stack boilerplate: MongoDB (Docker) + Express 5 + Angular 22 + Node 22, in TypeScript.

scripts.build: node init && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mean/server && npm run build -w @mean/client
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mean/shared" "npm run dev -w @mean/server" "npm run dev -w @mean/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @mean/server && npm run typecheck -w @mean/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @mean/server && npm run test -w @mean/client
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs && npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
